why_ai: Value is a night out in a physical auditorium with crews serving food and turning rooms; AI cannot deliver the venue, so the residual risk is more home entertainment competing for the evening, not AI doing the theatre's work.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical showtimes with grosses and per-caps known the next morning; only the booking call runs on feel.
why_digital: Films arrive as digital files and most tickets sell online, but the product is an in-person screening with food in a local building.

why_ai: Weekly calls rest on buyers' relationships with distributors and tacit market knowledge, though the forecasting half is automatable.
why_clarity: Grosses grade bookings quickly, but buyers work by feel and the cost side is settled weeks later by negotiation.
why_digital: Grosses, schedules and terms are data handled on screens and phones, sold through regional buyer relationships.

why_ai: Demand forecasting and grid-building are model work; the human keeps the final call and distributor commitments.
why_clarity: A weekly, repeated allocation scored by next weekend's admissions, with local reads still uncodified.
why_digital: Point-of-sale data in, a published schedule out, all on screens.

why_ai: Accrual and invoice checking automate; the post-run negotiation with each sales office stays relational.
why_clarity: Terms are exact and settlements checkable, with hundreds of near-identical engagements a quarter.
why_digital: Grosses, emails and statements in, journal entries and disputes out, mirroring the distributor side.

why_ai: Snacks and drinks are prepared and handed over by crews at a lobby counter, a structured physical setting, and patrons keep buying popcorn at the movies.
why_clarity: Per-capita spend and margins are measured to the cent across thousands of repeat transactions.
why_digital: Ingredients in, snacks and drinks served in person to patrons who are already in the building.

why_ai: A field, a screen, a projector and a snack bar run by a family on summer nights; nostalgia keeps the trade alive.
why_clarity: Each night's carloads grade the open-or-cancel call at once, though seasons are short and weather noisy.
why_digital: A physical field and in-person service, found through social posts and local word of mouth.

why_ai: Key and content checks and fault prediction automate; on-site hardware repairs keep a physical element.
why_clarity: A show either plays or it does not, every night, against a checkable schedule.
why_digital: Encrypted files, keys and telemetry worked on screens, delivering an in-theatre screening, serviced regionally.

why_ai: The town's only screen runs on the owner's hands-on work and community trust, with access to films a relationship.
why_clarity: Weekly operations repeat, but access and run-length outcomes depend on negotiation and thin local history.
why_digital: A local building serving neighbours in person, with tickets increasingly sold online.

why_ai: Devices are handed over and fitted in person by trained staff under ADA obligations; the need does not shrink.
why_clarity: Device counts are set by rule and each show reveals at once whether the device worked.
why_digital: Physical devices and in-person help at a local theatre, with captions as the digital element.

why_ai: Forecasting attendance by hour and drafting compliant schedules is mechanical software work.
why_clarity: Labour hours, lines and late starts are measured every shift across near-identical weeks.
why_digital: Presales and rosters in, a schedule out on an app, bought from SaaS vendors.

why_ai: Price setting and offer targeting automate; judgment remains on distributor floors and patron backlash.
why_clarity: Prices change constantly at scale, but true incrementality of passes and discounts is hard to observe.
why_digital: Prices, passes and loyalty run entirely in ticketing systems and apps.

why_ai: Internal analysts supporting buyers and pricing; durable only as long as the circuit values its own read.
why_clarity: Weekly reports recur and are graded by grosses, though attribution of decisions is loose.
why_digital: Point-of-sale and loyalty data analysed on screens for internal clients.

why_ai: Segmentation and campaign targeting are exactly what AI-native marketing software does.
why_clarity: Campaigns recur by release and are measured by redemption and attendance.
why_digital: Member data in, campaigns and dashboards out, sold as SaaS worldwide.

why_ai: Ticket sales and presale analytics are software at scale; the circuits' own apps already substitute.
why_clarity: Millions of near-identical transactions with instant outcomes.
why_digital: Fully online transactions and analytics.

why_ai: Installing and programming premium auditoriums mixes hardware, brand and studio relationships; premium demand is growing.
why_clarity: Format performance is measurable per film, but placement and programming are judgment calls.
why_digital: Hardware and remastered films delivered to physical auditoriums, sold through studio and exhibitor deals.

why_ai: Selling and scheduling pre-show inventory automates; long exhibitor agreements protect the network's position.
why_clarity: Campaigns recur and deliver against attendance, but advertiser outcomes are measured through occasional lift studies.
why_digital: Ad creative and attendance data in, digital pre-show playlists and reports out, sold to national advertisers.

why_ai: Category analysis automates; supply contracts rest on account relationships.
why_clarity: Annual category reviews repeat, graded slowly by sell-in volumes.
why_digital: Sales data analysed on screens and presented in account meetings.

why_ai: Agents sell their relationships with distributors and knowledge of client towns; the forecasting part automates.
why_clarity: Weekly bookings repeat and grosses grade them, but agents work by feel.
why_digital: Grosses and terms handled by phone and email for regional clients.

why_ai: Negotiating vendor programmes is relationship work at small scale; marketplaces automate the rest.
why_clarity: Vendor programmes are defined and renewed on contract cycles.
why_digital: Purchasing run through online marketplaces for members across the country.

why_ai: Conventions, lobbying and member relationships are in-person and political work AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Advocacy outcomes are diffuse and slow; surveys repeat annually.
why_digital: Mix of in-person conventions and digital publications for members.

why_ai: Long-lived property bets and tenant relationships with slow feedback stay human-led.
why_clarity: Lease underwriting repeats but outcomes arrive over years.
why_digital: Physical buildings leased to operators, analysed on screens, sold through relationships.

why_ai: Field engineers repair projectors and sound on site; remote monitoring automates detection, not repair.
why_clarity: Fault fixes are checkable and service visits repeat across thousands of screens.
why_digital: Physical equipment serviced on site, with remote telemetry as the digital part.

why_ai: File delivery and key generation are fully automatable operations.
why_clarity: Each delivery and key either works or fails, at high volume.
why_digital: Digital files and keys delivered over networks and satellite.

why_ai: Government authority and on-site investigation keep a human enforcer; the rules do not go away.
why_clarity: Device minimums and codes are explicit, though cases vary and resolve slowly.
why_digital: Complaints and inspections of physical premises within a jurisdiction.
